purpose: Pre-submission evaluation of published kcat predictors (DLKcat, UniKP) on the frozen homology-cold split, retrained on the frozen train partition (Mode B, primary) and, if checkpoints allow, as-published (Mode A, secondary context only).
claim_boundary: Internal homology-cold comparison only. No external benchmark claim, no prospective-pool scoring, no tuned BioCandidateRanker result.

data.label_policy: median of log10(kcat) per (sequence, canonical SMILES) pair, identical to all reported BioCandidateRanker runs

mode_b.definition: Each predictor retrained from scratch on the frozen train partition with its published default hyperparameters; validation used only for logging or early behavior observation, never for selection; test evaluated exactly once per seed by the shared evaluator.

unikp.features: frozen pretrained SMILES transformer (trfm_12_23000.pkl, 256-dim) + frozen ProtT5-XL-UniRef50 mean-pooled sequence embeddings (1024-dim), concatenated; embeddings computed once over unique rows and cached
unikp.regressor: sklearn ExtraTreesRegressor with library defaults, random_state per seed

dlkcat.hyperparameters: published setting radius2 ngram3 dim20 layer_gnn3 window11 layer_cnn3 layer_output3 lr1e-3 lr_decay0.5 decay_interval10 weight_decay1e-6 iteration50
dlkcat.label_encoding: log2(kcat) internally (upstream convention), converted to log10 for reporting
dlkcat.split: upstream 80/10/10 random split replaced by the frozen homology-cold partition; model seed from torch.manual_seed per seed; final epoch-50 model evaluated

mode_a.definition: As-published checkpoints evaluated on the frozen test partition. Their training corpora subsume this corpus, so results are a leakage-favorable upper reference and are never compared head-to-head with Mode B in the primary table.
mode_a.status: secondary; run only after Mode B if schedule allows

overlap_audit: Exact sequence and (sequence, SMILES) overlap between each predictor's published training corpus and the frozen test partition is computed and reported alongside Mode A results.

evaluation.prohibition: No test partition row, label, or metric may inform any training, embedding, vocabulary, or hyperparameter decision. Validation rows may not enter ExtraTrees or DLKcat training inputs.

unikp_deployment.local_root: external deployment directory recorded in scripts' --development-corpus defaults
